title: Garmin Training Status Drift
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift ride exports (`zwift:activity`).
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as file inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=garmin:activity
| bin _time span=1w
| stats latest(training_status) as training_status, avg(training_load) as avg_load by athlete _time
| where training_status="Unproductive" OR training_status="Overreaching"
| sort - _time
description: Tracks Garmin training-status labels week by week and highlights stretches where your workload is high but the platform says your fitness is moving backward.
value: A plan can look busy while still being counterproductive; surfacing unproductive or overreaching weeks helps you recover before motivation and form fall apart.
implementation: Forward Garmin activity summaries with training-status metadata; review weekly and step back when unproductive weeks start stacking up.
visualization: Weekly table of athlete, training status, and average load.
grandmaExplanation: It watches when Garmin starts calling your recent training unproductive or overreaching instead of helping you improve.
